name: What actually happens during a full primary bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: What actually happens during a full primary bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A primary bathroom remodel can involve design, selections, permit coordination, demolition, plumbing and electrical work, installation, inspections, and a final walkthrough. The order matters: unresolved selections or unavailable tile and vanities can delay construction after demolition starts. Context: Elite Remodeling & Design describes a process that runs from consultation and design development through permitting, construction, and final inspection. Key factors: layout changes, custom materials, inspection requirements, concealed conditions, and decision speed. Practical guidance: approve the scope and selections before demolition, confirm who coordinates permits, and ask how changes are priced. Keep a written decision log for fixtures, tile patterns, lighting, and hardware. A coordinated design-build process can reduce handoff confusion between planning and field work.
acceptedAnswer.description: The usual sequence is consultation, layout and design, material selections, permit coordination when needed, demolition, rough plumbing and electrical, waterproofing, tile and cabinetry, fixtures, inspections, and final completion. Elite Remodeling & Design connects these stages so design decisions are carried into construction.
